title: Constant-depth circuits for polynomial GCD over any characteristic
read: Introduction and statements; complete applicable text of sections 2-5, including interpolation, root statements, symmetric and multi-symmetric proofs, resultant and root-evaluation proofs, piecewise GCD definition and filtering/GCD proofs, Hasse/root discussion, small-characteristic factor proof and its rational root-evaluation lemma. Statements and proofs referenced but not reproduced from the older Furstenberg/factor paper are not newly audited here.
limitations: No new positive source import. GCD requires coefficient input and large field; same-field factor closure requires polynomial cardinality and returns a multiplicity-dependent Frobenius power. Unqualified root truncation display invokes the interpolation corollary with its node-count hypothesis. General higher-multiplicity diagonal estimate is not newly certified.
actual_attempts: Coefficient-fed fixed monic division, known-root filtering of actual invariant control, graph factor with multiplicity one, and comparison of existing field-pivot and literal-clause charts. No special binary coefficient access or descent was obtained.
